_comment: Settings for tooling/report/buildReport.js — the stakeholder summary report (Step 1, 2026-09-24). One entry per execution file under execFiles. Values in testData/accounts are read from the data file by jsonPath and may use ADR-022 tokens ({{run.x}} / {{last.x}}), resolved against the run's lastRun.json. Suite roles come from each suite's "Role" / "Setup" fields in the execution file.
waitPatterns: (?:My progress|Class data) settled=\w+ after \d+ ms \(\d+ reads?\)

learningPath.json.title: Cambridge One – Learning Path Test Report
learningPath.json.mode: Full run — creates a new teacher, learner and class

learningPathDebug.json.title: Cambridge One – Learning Path Debug Report
learningPathDebug.json.mode: Debug run — reuses the previous run's accounts and class (creates nothing)
